ソフトウェアは、大手素材メーカーやものづくり企業の研究現場で継続的に利用されており、研究データの管理・共有から材料探索の支援まで、データ駆動型研究開発を支える基盤として活用されています。 【仕事概要】 MI-6 の中核ソフトウェア miHub® の開発組織を率い、CEO・プロダクトオーナーが定めるプロダクト方針をロードマップ・開発計画・チーム配置・リリースへ最短で変換する責任を持つポジションです。 「エンジニアリングマネージャー」が担当チームの開発プロセスと組織運営を担うのに対し、本ポジションはプロダクト方針からデリバリまでの一貫した責任を負います。What / Why はプロダクトオーナー・プロダクトマネージャーと協業して定め、When / How / Who と開発デリバリに責任を持ちます。開発計画をエンジニアリードやアーキテクトと議論・合意しながら、顧客価値までの期間を最短化します。 【責務】 ・CEO / プロダクトオーナーのプロダクト方針を、開発ロードマップ・開発計画・チーム配置・リリース計画へ変換し、継続的に反映されている状態に責任を持つ ・プロダクト戦略から実装までの翻訳責任を担い、方針と開発現場の間の空白を解消する ・優先順位・依存関係・スコープ・リソース・技術的制約を横断して判断し、最短経路でリリースへ進める ・プロダクト開発組織の採用・評価・配置をプロダクト戦略と整合させる 【業務内容】 ・プロダクト方針・ロードマップ策定への参画と、開発計画（スコープ・優先順位・順序・リソース配分・リリース計画）への落とし込み ・複数開発チーム横断の優先順位づけ・チーム配置・リリース管理 ・エンジニア・プロダクトマネージャーと連携したアーキテクチャ・技術的トレードオフの意思決定 ・適切な QCD で継続的にリリースされる状態の構築と維持、開発プロセスの改善 ・エンジニアの採用・評価・配置・組織設計 【必須スキル】 ○経験 ・企業でのソフトウェア開発実務経験 5年以上 ・継続的に利用されるソフトウェアプロダクトについて、ロードマップと複数回のプロダクションリリースに責任を持った経験 ・上位のプロダクト方針・事業方針を、自らエンジニアリングのスコープ・優先順位・開発計画・リソース配分・リリース計画へ変換した経験 ・2チーム以上、または Web / ML / SRE 等の異なるエンジニアリング機能を横断してデリバリーを統合した経験 ・アーキテクチャ・技術的制約・技術負債・品質・開発速度のトレードオフを、エンジニアメンバーと自立して議論できること（現時点でのコーディング業務は必須ではありません） ・CEO / プロダクトオーナー / Engineering チームと日本語で高度な議論ができること ○志向性 ・技術・事業・組織の観点で最適な意思決定を行い、事業成長を推進しようとすること ・組織・プロセス・ロードマップが完成していない状態から、自ら実行の仕組みを作ることに挑戦したいこと ・課題に対し、チーム内外との建設的な対話で最適な解決策を導き出そうとすること 【歓迎スキル】 ・素材・化学・研究開発のバックグラウンド ・Scientific software / R&D software / CAE・シミュレーション / ELN・LIMS / ケモインフォマティクス / 研究データ基盤の開発経験 ・機械学習・データ集約型プロダクトと Web プロダクトの両方を含むチームを率いた経験 ・スタートアップ / スケールアップで、開発組織の立ち上げ・拡大を担った経験 ・Enterprise B2B で、顧客要求とプロダクト戦略のトレードオフを判断した経験 ・大学やメーカーにおける研究開発の経験 【求める人物像】 ・当社のミッションと価値観に共感し、それを推進する意欲を持った方 ・製造業で長期にわたり使われ続けるプロダクトの開発に意欲のある方 ・主体的に行動し、事業拡大に貢献できる方 【待遇・勤務地】 年収 750万円〜1200万円（30時間分のみなし残業代を含む）／原則フルリモート勤務（月数回オフサイトミーティングあり）／正社員（試用期間6ヶ月）／フレックスタイム制（コアタイム11:00〜16:00）／ストックオプション制度あり 【応募】 詳細・応募は HERP の求人票から：https://herp.careers/v1/misix/voBrIrva44-G

review_candidates.title: HR Project Delivery Manager
review_candidates.description: About Us Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere. Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated. The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work. At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all. About The Role As our customer base evolves to serve large global enterprises, we are shifting from fragmented, regional ops handoffs to a dedicated, high-touch delivery model. The Forward Deployed Operations Manager (FD-OM) acts as the single operational point of contact for our enterprise clients and internal Customer Success teams. In this role, you will lead complex, multi-country onboarding implementations end-to-end. You will sit at the intersection of enterprise project management, global employment compliance, customer activation, and operational delivery—ensuring seamless global expansions and long-term customer satisfaction. What You Will Do Enterprise Implementation & Project Management End-to-End Onboarding: Own and project manage end-to-end, multi-country EOR onboarding programs from HR Operations’ perspective for enterprise clients, managing timelines, risk registers, and critical path milestones. Single Point of Contact: Serve as the primary operational partner for enterprise Customer POCs, ensuring a coordinated and unified HR operations service delivery experience during project implementation,. Internal Alignment: Coordinate within internal HR Ops regional teams in close partnership with Customer Success, Sales teams to align resources and streamline program execution Global Compliance & Operational Delivery Compliance Oversight: Navigate complex international labor laws, visa/immigration requirements, benefits administration, and localized employment contract - acting as a consultant to our Customers to deliver on value across multiple workstreams and tailor our offering to Customer’s needs Local Ops Integration: Translate complex in-country operational nuances into clear action plans for the customer while maintaining strict adherence to local regulations. Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and resolve operational blockers, regulatory risks, and payroll setup delays across multiple jurisdictions. Customer Relationship & Activation Customer Success Partnership: Partner closely with assigned Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to bridge operational delivery with long-term strategic account growth. Adoption & Happiness: Drive client activation and platform adoption, ensuring a white-glove onboarding experience for both enterprise admins and international employees. Escalations & Problem-Solving: Act as the direct escalation point for complex operational inquiries, resolving issues with high speed and precision. Operational Scaling & Process Improvement Playbook Development: Document and refine implementation playbooks, scalable workflows, and enterprise delivery standards to continuously decrease time-to-first-payroll. Voice of Customer: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to feed enterprise client requirements back into the platform roadmap. Minimum Requirements What we’re looking for: Relevant Experience: 4+ years in Enterprise Implementation, Customer Onboarding, Technical Project Management, or Operations Delivery—ideally within the EOR, Payroll, Global HR Tech, or SaaS space. Domain Knowledge: Direct exposure to global employment mechanics (Employer of Record, global payroll, employment law basics, or HR operations). Enterprise Project Management: Proven track record of managing multi-stakeholder, multi-country projects using formal frameworks (PMP, Agile, or equivalent experience). Client-Facing Presence: Excellent communication and consultative leadership skills; comfortable steering calls with VP/C-suite stakeholders at Fortune 500 or high-growth enterprise companies. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and translate complex regulatory/operational realities into simple, actionable steps for clients. Preferred Requirements Experience handling complex, high-volume employee transfers (TUPE, M&A transitions, or enterprise-wide migrations). International work experience across EMEA, LATAM, or APAC regions. Core Competencies & KPIs Core Competencies Stakeholder Orchestration: Keeping clients, local ops, and CSMs aligned on timeline and scope. Operational Agility: Unblocking localized compliance hurdles quickly without compromising governance. Empathy & Drive: Delivering high customer satisfaction during high-stakes corporate expansions. Success Metrics (KPIs) Time-to-Activation / Speed-to-Onboard: Minimizing the cycle time from contract signing to employee active state. Customer Satisfaction (CSAT / NPS): High satisfaction scores during the onboarding and implementation phase. Implementation Accuracy: Zero compliance or payroll setup errors during the first pay run. Account Retention & Expansion Readiness: Smooth handoff to CSMs with fully activated platform usage. Our ranges are established using objective market benchmarking data for this level of work. Final placement within the range is determined by gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate's relevant skills, experience, and specific qualifications for the role. Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows: Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary. Non-Sales Roles: This position is eligible for an annual bonus which is paid dependent on various factors, including and without limitation, individual and company performance in addition to base salary. Benefits G-P values its employees and offers excellent benefits and perks including generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, spending accounts, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, sabbatical after 5 years and more. Individuals residing, or applying to work, in the United States: California or Philadelphia , Pennsylvania, please review the following additional information: G-P will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Act Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Act Ordinance. Los Angeles applicants can review additional information regarding the Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act here: Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and Philadelphia applicants can review information pertaining to Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance here: Fair Chance Poster. Any consideration of a candidate’s background check with arrest or conviction records will include an individualized assessment based on the factors required by applicable law, including the candidate’s specific record and the duties and requirements of the specific job. If you need an accommodation due to a disability during the interview process, please contact us at careers@g-p.com.

Mit dem Aareon Property Management System, basierend auf intelligenten Softwarelösungen, ermöglicht das Unternehmen die effiziente Verwaltung und Instandhaltung von Wohn - und Gewerbeimmobilien - und schafft digitale Erlebnisse für die Beteiligten. review_candidates.title: Government Relations Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description JOE13 is a comprehensive business solutions provider with over 13 years of market experience, serving clients across multiple sectors. The company offers integrated services that span HR and workforce solutions, merchandising, promotion and activation, and marketing. JOE13 also operates in telecom services, logistics through Joe Express, and delivers advanced software and AI-driven tools. In addition, the company provides tailored financial solutions, enabling organizations to streamline operations and drive growth through a single, trusted partner. Role Description The Government Relations Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Jeddah. This role is responsible for building and maintaining effective relationships with government entities, regulators, and public sector stakeholders relevant to JOE13’s business activities. Day-to-day tasks include monitoring legislative and regulatory developments, preparing briefs and reports, and advising internal teams on compliance and policy implications. The specialist will coordinate and attend meetings with government officials, draft official correspondence and documentation, and support the representation of JOE13 in public affairs initiatives. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to align business strategies with governmental requirements and contributing to advocacy efforts that support the company’s interests. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Government Relations and Governmental Affairs, with proven experience engaging public sector institutions. Candidates should possess knowledge of Government structures and processes, including familiarity with relevant regulations and policy frameworks. Candidates should possess excellent Communication abilities, including clear written and verbal communication for diverse internal and external audiences. Candidates should possess capabilities in Public Affairs, including stakeholder engagement, advocacy, and representation of organizational interests. Relevant bachelor’s degree in political science, public administration, law, business, or a related field. Experience working with government agencies or in a government relations/public affairs role, preferably within the region. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret regulatory information and propose practical solutions. High level of professionalism, integrity, and cultural awareness, with the ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment. Proficiency in office productivity tools and ability to prepare reports, presentations, and official documentation.
